lines.japanese: 「いや、おれは針生さんと組むよ」
lines.english: “No. I'll pair up with Hariu.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？」
lines.english: “What?”

lines.japanese: 付きあってるからって、いつでもどこでも二人セットみたいに考えられるのは、ちょっと恥ずかしい。渡来さんにしても、そう思うところはあるはずだ。
lines.english: It was a little embarrassing to have people assume that dating meant we had to be joined at the hip everywhere we went. Watarai must have felt the same way to some extent.

lines.japanese: それに、針生さんからもっと世界遺産の話を聞きたいとも思っていた。学校ではちょっと不完全燃焼の感があったんだ。
lines.english: Besides, I wanted to hear more from Hariu about World Heritage Sites. Our conversation at school had left me a little unsatisfied.

lines.japanese: 「ふーん。いんじゃない」
lines.english: “Huh. Fine by me.”

lines.japanese: 「班長、理由を聞いてもいいかな」
lines.english: “May I ask why, team leader?”

lines.japanese: 「理由ってほどじゃないけど、なんとなく、こういうときは男女で分かれるのが普通かなって」
lines.english: “It's not much of a reason. I just thought that in a situation like this, splitting into men and women would be the usual thing to do.”

lines.japanese: 「ま、たしかに」
lines.english: “I guess that's true.”

lines.japanese: 渡来さんはぎこちなく頷いた。
lines.english: Watarai nodded stiffly.

lines.japanese: なにか言いたげな目をしていたのは、もしかして僕と組みたいなんて思ってくれていたからだろうか。まさか。照れ屋の彼女に限ってそれはない。
lines.english: Did her eyes look as if she wanted to say something because she had hoped to pair up with me? No. She was far too shy for that.

lines.japanese: 「異論がないなら始めるか。羽田、俺たちの受け持ちはどこだ」
lines.english: “If there are no objections, let's begin. Haneda, where's our section?”

lines.japanese: 「ええと、渡来さんたちがＣ列までだから、おれたちはＤ列からですね。行きましょう」
lines.english: “Let's see. Watarai and Yamashina have through Row C, so we start at Row D. Let's go.”

lines.japanese: 僕は配置図を頼りに、年上の同級生を連れて歩きだした。
lines.english: Using the floor plan as a guide, I led my older classmate away.

lines.japanese: 「ところで針生さん、あの話の続きを聞いてもいいですか」
lines.english: “By the way, Hariu, could you continue that story?”

lines.japanese: 「あの話？　あァ、モヘンジョ＝ダロの上下水道か。なに、おまえも興味持ったわけ」
lines.english: “That story? Oh, Mohenjo-daro's water and sewer systems. What, you're interested now too?”

lines.japanese: 「はい、せっかく本屋さんにいるんだから、資料もたくさんあると思うんです」
lines.english: “Yes. Since we're in a bookstore, I thought there would be plenty of material here.”

lines.japanese: 「ふン、貪欲な探究心だな。嫌いじゃないぜ、チェリーボーイ。さあ、ブックパーティーを始めよう」
lines.english: “Hmph. What a ravenous hunger for knowledge. I don't dislike it, Cherry Boy. Let the book party begin.”

lines.japanese: 「ふたりとも、仕事だけはちゃんとやんなー？」
lines.english: “You two had better actually work, okay?”

lines.japanese: 僕らは渡来さんに釘を刺された。
lines.english: Watarai warned us.

lines.japanese: だけど僕らは、釘が刺さったまま『写真で見よう！　感動の世界遺産』に心を奪われていた。
lines.english: But even with her warning lodged firmly in us, *See Them in Photographs! The World's Most Moving Heritage Sites* had already stolen our hearts.

lines.japanese: 「見ろ羽田。古代都市スコタイの塔だ。こんなもん生で見た日にはおまえ、どうする。いいよなァ、この尖りっぷり。頭の先まで尖ってるなんて、こいつら全員ロックにも程がある。二百年で滅んだ儚さもいとおかしだ」
lines.english: “Look, Haneda. The towers of the ancient city of Sukhothai. What would you do if you saw these in person? Look how sharp they are. Even the tops of their heads come to points. Every last one is too rock for words. And the pathos of it all vanishing in two hundred years—how exquisitely charming.”

lines.japanese: 「針生さん、建造物もいいですけど、自然と一体化した風景も素晴らしいですよ。見てください、このカッパドキア。触れてみたくなる岩肌の質感がたまらないなあ。ロックだけにロックですよ」
lines.english: “The buildings are wonderful, Hariu, but the landscapes fused with nature are magnificent too. Look at Cappadocia. That texture on the rock makes me ache to touch it. And since it's rock, it rocks.”

lines.japanese: 「待て羽田、その台詞はまだ口にするな」
lines.english: “Wait, Haneda. Don't say that line yet.”

lines.japanese: 「えっ、どうしてですか？」
lines.english: “What? Why not?”

lines.japanese: 「そいつは、現地でふたり見上げる日まで取っておけ」
lines.english: “Save it until the day we stand there together and look up at it.”

lines.japanese: 「針生さん……行きましょう、いつか必ず」
lines.english: “Hariu... Let's go. Someday, without fail.”

lines.japanese: 「仕事しろよ」
lines.english: “Do your damn job.”

lines.japanese: 怒られた。
lines.english: We got scolded.

lines.japanese: 「そうは言うけど渡来さん、見てよこのフレスコ画、本当にかっこいいんだ」
lines.english: “I know what you're saying, Watarai, but look at this fresco. It's genuinely cool.”

lines.japanese: 「あれ、ほんとだカッチョイ──」
lines.english: “Hey, it really is coo—”

lines.japanese: 「──じゃなくて、駄目だよ、遊んでたら時間内に終わらないよ？」
lines.english: “—no! If you play around, we won't finish in time.”

lines.japanese: 「はン、そんなことァ、おいおい考えりゃいい。それより羽田、この歴史地区見ろよ。魂が揺さぶられるとはまさにこのことだ」
lines.english: “Hah. We can worry about that as we go. More importantly, Haneda, look at this historic district. This is what it means to have your soul shaken.”

lines.japanese: 「うわあ、本当だ。なんだろう、この懐かしくないのに懐かしい感覚。あたかも種の根幹に訴えかけてくるようですね」
lines.english: “Wow, you're right. What is this feeling? Nostalgic, even though I've never known it. It's as if it appeals to the very roots of our species.”

lines.japanese: 「訴えてこないっつの。いいから働けっ！」
lines.english: “It does not. Now get to work!”

lines.japanese: 「ああっ、返してよ渡来さん」
lines.english: “Oh, give it back, Watarai.”

lines.japanese: 写真集は没収されてしまった。
lines.english: She confiscated the photography book.

lines.japanese: やはりこの種の憧憬は、男にしか湧きえない情感なのだろうか。
lines.english: Perhaps this kind of longing truly was an emotion only men could feel.

lines.japanese: 「でも本当にいいんだけどなあ。このロス・グラシアレスなんか『生きている氷河』って呼ばれてるんだよ」
lines.english: “But it really is wonderful. Los Glaciares here is called ‘the living glacier.’”

lines.japanese: 「へえ、吸いこまれそう」
lines.english: “Oh. I feel like it could pull me in.”

lines.japanese: 「あーこら、山科を巻きこむなっ」
lines.english: “Hey! Don't drag Yamashina into this!”

lines.japanese: 隙を見て取りかえした写真集だったけど、また没収されてしまった。
lines.english: I had seized an opening and taken the book back, but she confiscated it again.

lines.japanese: 「これは預かっとく。さぼった分もキリキリ働くように。ぜんぶ終わらなかったら、羽田君と針生先輩のせいだからね」
lines.english: “I’m holding on to this. Now work hard enough to make up for all the slacking. If we don’t finish everything, it’ll be your fault and Kuroudo’s.”

lines.japanese: 山科さんを連れて、渡来さんは自身の担当区域へ帰っていった。
lines.english: Taking Yamashina with her, Watarai returned to their assigned section.

lines.japanese: 「まあ、仕方ないですよね。おれたちも、そろそろ本腰入れて始めましょう」
lines.english: “Well, we had that coming. We should finally buckle down and get started.”

lines.japanese: 僕たちも与えられた業務に精を出すのだった。
lines.english: We devoted ourselves to the work we had been given.

lines.japanese: しかし針生さんは負けず嫌いだった。
lines.english: But Hariu hated losing.

lines.japanese: 「ふン、そろそろ頃合だな。羽田」
lines.english: “Hmph. The time has come, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: 作業を始めて一時間ほどが経過したころ、彼が不意に僕を呼んだ。
lines.english: About an hour after we began working, he suddenly called to me.

lines.japanese: 「はい、なんでしょう」
lines.english: “Yes? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「時計合わせ１８時４５分。これより写真集奪還作戦、名付けてオペレーション『ワンモア・ロマンス』を開始する。おまえ、敵陣の様子を見てこい」
lines.english: “Synchronize watches: eighteen forty-five. Operation Photograph Recovery, codename ‘One More Romance,’ begins now. Reconnoiter the enemy position.”

lines.japanese: 「お、おれがですか」
lines.english: “M-me?”

lines.japanese: 「飛車が近付けば警戒される。哨戒任務には歩が適任でしょう」
lines.english: “A rook would put them on alert. A pawn is the ideal unit for reconnaissance.”

lines.japanese: 「おれ、歩だったんだ」
lines.english: “So I'm a pawn.”

lines.japanese: 「誇れよホーリーナイト、おまえはただの歩じゃない。フルアーマー歩だ。戦果を期待する」
lines.english: “Take pride, Holy Knight. You're no ordinary pawn. You're a full-armor pawn. I expect results.”

lines.japanese: 「はあ」
lines.english: “Right.”

lines.japanese: よく分からないまま、僕は前線へ送りだされた。
lines.english: Without really understanding what was happening, I was sent to the front.

lines.japanese: 「んっと、向こうか……」
lines.english: “Let's see. They should be over there...”

lines.japanese: 簡易マップと話し声を頼りに、渡来さんたちの担当区域へ近付いてゆく。
lines.english: Using the simple map and the sound of voices, I approached Watarai and Yamashina's section.

lines.japanese: とりあえず後ろから様子を窺ってみよう。僕は一列裏の棚に身を潜めた。
lines.english: For now, I would observe them from behind. I concealed myself in the aisle one row over.

lines.japanese: 「ほんっとにアイツはもう、天然っていうかＫＹっていうか、言わなくていいこと言ったりするしさー」
lines.english: “Honestly, that guy. He's either naturally clueless or just plain oblivious. And he'll say things he never needed to say...”

lines.japanese: 「でも、そこが彼のいいとこだと思うよ。気苦労が絶えないっていうのは容易に想像できるけど」
lines.english: “But I think that's one of his good qualities. Though I can easily imagine how much grief it causes you.”

lines.japanese: 彼女たちは楽しそうに、いったい誰の話をしているんだろう。
lines.english: They sounded as though they were enjoying themselves. Who could they be talking about?

lines.japanese: 気にはなるけれど、僕は針生さんのお使いでこうしているだけだ。ガールズトークを盗み聞きしに来たわけじゃない。
lines.english: I was curious, but I was only here on an errand for Hariu. I hadn't come to eavesdrop on girl talk.

lines.japanese: 棚の陰から慎重に頭だけ出して、ふたりの姿を確認した。脚立に乗って、高い段に本を並べている。
lines.english: I cautiously poked my head around the shelf and checked on them. They stood on stepladders, arranging books on the higher shelves.

lines.japanese: ふたりが背中を向けているのをいいことに、僕はいっそう首を伸ばして『写真で見よう！　感動の世界遺産』を探し──
lines.english: With both their backs turned, I craned my neck farther and searched for *See Them in Photographs! The World's Most Moving Heritage Sites*—

lines.japanese: ──あった。足元のプラスチック籠に入ってる。
lines.english: —there it was, in a plastic basket at their feet.

lines.japanese: 「あんなのに可愛い彼女がいるって言うんだから、世も末だよね」
lines.english: “And then you find out a thing like that has a cute girlfriend. The world's coming to an end.”

lines.japanese: 「くすっ、お似合いだと思うよ」
lines.english: “Hehe. I think they suit each other.”

lines.japanese: ふたりは作業をしながら、加えて雑談にも花を咲かせている。いまなら背後への意識は薄いだろう。
lines.english: They kept up a lively conversation as they worked. Their attention would be far from anything behind them right now.

lines.japanese: よし。針生長官から下された指令はあくまで偵察任務だけれど、前線の状況を鑑みて予定変更。対象を奪取して帰ろう。
lines.english: All right. Commander Hariu had ordered reconnaissance only, but the conditions at the front called for a change of plans. I would seize the target and return.

lines.japanese: 僕は腰を落とし、ゆっくり忍び足で近付いていった。
lines.english: I lowered my body and crept toward them.

lines.japanese: 「山科、ちょお他人事ー。いっぺんアレと付きあってみー、疲れるから」
lines.english: “Yamashina, don't act like it has nothing to do with you. Try dating that once. It's exhausting.”

lines.japanese: 「ふーん。じゃあ付きあってみようかなあ」
lines.english: “Hmm. Maybe I will.”

lines.japanese: 「うそ、山科あーゆーのイケるクチ？」
lines.english: “Seriously? You're into guys like that?”

lines.japanese: 「どうかな。言葉は適切じゃないけど、ひとのものっていう意識がなかったら、惹かれていっちゃうかもね」
lines.english: “I don't know. This may be a poor way to put it, but if I didn't think of him as belonging to someone else, I might find myself drawn to him.”

lines.japanese: えっ？
lines.english: What?

lines.japanese: 気になる話が耳に入ってしまった。山科さんには好きなひとがいるのだろうか。
lines.english: Something I couldn't ignore had reached my ears. Did Yamashina have someone she liked?

lines.japanese: どんな男だろう。いまの話を聞くかぎり、あまり誉められた印象ではなかった気がするけれど──
lines.english: What sort of man was he? Judging by what I had just heard, the picture they painted of him didn't sound very flattering—

lines.japanese: 「ちょっと、勘弁してよ山科サン？　あの子、目先の情に流されて、遠くの本質には盲目なところあるんだから」
lines.english: “Come on, Yamashina. Spare me, okay? That boy gets carried away by whatever tugs at his heart right then and loses sight of what really matters.”

lines.japanese: 「またそんなこと言うー。ほんとは信じてるくせに」
lines.english: “There you go again. You trust him, really.”

lines.japanese: 「いやー、ぶっちゃけウル目で迫られたら、フラっと流されちゃいそうだよ、うちのタカシは」
lines.english: “I mean, honestly, if some girl came at him with tears in her eyes, our Takashi might just get carried away.”

lines.japanese: 「へ？　おれ？」
lines.english: “Huh? Me?”

lines.japanese: 思わず声が漏れてしまった。
lines.english: The words escaped me before I could stop them.
“Hm?”

lines.japanese: 「うえっ、羽田君！？」
lines.english: “Wha—Haneda?!”

lines.japanese: 「あっ！　渡来さん、本！」
lines.english: “Ah! Watarai, the books!”

lines.japanese: 「たっ！」
lines.english: “Ah!”

lines.japanese: 「痛たたた……！」
lines.english: “Owowow...!”

lines.japanese: 振りかえった渡来さんの手から、文庫本が降りそそいできた。
lines.english: Paperbacks rained down from Watarai's hands as she spun around.

lines.japanese: 「ええっ、なんで羽田君……や、ごめん、大丈夫！？」
lines.english: “What are you doing here, Haneda...? No, sorry! Are you okay?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、いや、こちらこそ……あたっ」
lines.english: “Oh, no, I'm the one who... Ow.”

lines.japanese: ごん、と最後にもう一冊、背表紙の角が直撃したのは、うっかり乙女の聖域を見上げてしまった僕への天罰だったのかもしれない。
lines.english: Thump. One final book struck me squarely with the corner of its spine. Perhaps it was divine punishment for accidentally looking up into a maiden's sacred territory.

lines.japanese: 「ごめん、平気？　たんこぶできてない？」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. Are you all right? Do you have a bump?”

lines.japanese: 「私、救急箱借りてこようか？」
lines.english: “Should I ask for the first-aid kit?”

lines.japanese: 「い、いえ、平気です、そんな固い本はなかったですから」
lines.english: “N-no, thank you. I am quite all right. None of the books were particularly hard.”

lines.japanese: 「……なんで敬語？」
lines.english: “...Why are you talking so formally?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、そだ。まさかいまの会話聞いてた？」
lines.english: “Oh, right. You didn't happen to hear what we were saying, did you?”

lines.japanese: 「いや聞いてないよ」
lines.english: “No. I didn't hear anything.”

lines.japanese: 僕は何故だか嘘をついた。
lines.english: For some reason, I lied.

lines.japanese: 「ほんとに？　羽田君、私の目を見て言ってごらん」
lines.english: “Really? Look me in the eyes and say that, Haneda.”

lines.japanese: ごめん渡来さん、いま頭を上げるわけにはいかないよ。ところで僕はいつまで見上げているつもりなんだろう。
lines.english: Sorry, Watarai, but I can't raise my head just now. Then again, how long am I planning to keep looking up?

lines.japanese: こうして羽田班の一日バイトは終わった。
lines.english: And so the Haneda team's day at the bookstore came to an end.
